title: Fantastic War
text: The Spanish–Portuguese War (1762–1763) or Fantastic War was fought as part of the Seven Years' War. The first and main theatre of the war was an invasion of Portugal by Spain in alliance with France against the Anglo-Portuguese Alliance, which ended after three disastrous invasions. The second theatre was a Spanish invasion of Portuguese colonies in South America. Though tactically successful for the Spanish in the strategically important area on and near the River Plate, their gains there were largely given up in the peace negotiations, resulting in a strategic success for the Portuguese in South America.
